correctness.rationale: Theorem covers fixed positive chord rate and divergent two-sided chord separations. Directed tree first-clock probabilities yield the exact homogeneous message, bridge kernel and four-ray perturbations; the integrated four-ray correction cancels the isolated bridge term to give the stated beta integral. An explicit factorial descending-priority influence bound justifies summability and the graph-to-tree limit. Strict stochastic dominance of Beta(1,rate) and monotonicity of g give unique transition and endpoint limits. A fresh standard-library finite first-clock dynamic program on 20-vertex cycles matched the limiting formula at four rates and verified the closed form at rate one, supplementary to proof.

value.rationale: The exact sign reversal quantifies a genuine Braess-type loss of terminal adsorption from an additional legal dimer bond. Its sign is controlled by a unique physically meaningful rate threshold despite zero bulk-density effect, revealing the competition between bridge acceptance and depletion on four rays. Both the order-one exact constant at unit rate and the opposite weak-rate effect provide a natural finite-defect benchmark beyond routine homogeneous jamming density.
